title: 2022 AMC 12B Problem 5
statement: The point \((-1, -2)\) is rotated \(270^\circ\) counterclockwise about the point \((3, 1).\) What are the coordinates of its new position?

solutions.text:
Relative to the center \((3, 1),\) the point is at \((-1 - 3,\, -2 - 1) = (-4, -3).\)

A \(270^\circ\) counterclockwise rotation sends \((x, y)\) to \((y, -x),\) so \((-4, -3)\) becomes \((-3, 4).\)

Translating back gives \((3 - 3,\, 1 + 4) = (0, 5).\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Translate so the center of rotation is the origin, rotate, then translate back
A \(270^\circ\) counterclockwise rotation sends \((x, y)\) to \((y, -x)\)
